note: Post-MVP row 2: sanitizers + fuzzing against the release SHA. ASan leg = go test -asan over the bridge packages — ASan's malloc interception is global at link time, so the Rust staticlib's heap operations ARE instrumented through it (stable-Rust -Zsanitizer needs nightly; this is the honest stable-toolchain equivalent). TSan-equivalent leg = go test -race over all six runtime packages (cross-task detector on the same paths spike 3 proved). Fuzz leg = tools/fuzz/hyfuzz.py — crash-class invariants (no hang / no crash / no ICE) over token salad, corpus mutations, and nest bombs; coverage-guided cargo-fuzz needs nightly rust, documented cut. THRESHOLDS PRE-REGISTERED: every command exits 0. Fail-soft on purpose: one leg failing must not hide the others.

commands.name: build-hyb
commands.run: export PATH=/tmp/go/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd compiler && cargo build --release -p hyb --quiet && test -x ./target/release/hyb && echo HYB-BUILT

commands.name: asan-bridge
commands.run:
export PATH=/tmp/go/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CGO_ENABLED=1 && rm -rf /tmp/asanws && mkdir -p /tmp/asanws/lib && printf 'module hybrid.program

go 1.26
' > /tmp/asanws/go.mod && cp -r runtime/go/* /tmp/asanws/ && (cd runtime/rust/hyrt && cargo build --release --quiet) && cp runtime/rust/hyrt/target/release/libhyrt.a /tmp/asanws/lib/ && cd /tmp/asanws && go test -asan -count=1 -timeout 8m ./jsonbinding ./regexbinding ./sha3binding ./hybridge 2>&1 | tail -20

commands.name: race-bridge
commands.run:
export PATH=/tmp/go/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CGO_ENABLED=1 && rm -rf /tmp/racews && mkdir -p /tmp/racews/lib && printf 'module hybrid.program

go 1.26
' > /tmp/racews/go.mod && cp -r runtime/go/* /tmp/racews/ && cp runtime/rust/hyrt/target/release/libhyrt.a /tmp/racews/lib/ 2>/dev/null || (cd runtime/rust/hyrt && cargo build --release --quiet && cp target/release/libhyrt.a /tmp/racews/lib/) && cd /tmp/racews && go test -race -count=1 -timeout 8m ./... 2>&1 | tail -12

commands.name: fuzz-parser-checker
commands.run: export PATH=/tmp/go/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && python3 tools/fuzz/hyfuzz.py --hyb compiler/target/release/hyb --corpus tests/checker-corpus --cases 800 --seed 20261014 --timeout 10
